# Fetch all sent transactions for the year, paginating through all pages
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-01-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-18',
        page_limit=20,
        page_index=page_index
    )
    if not page:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter for internet bill payments
internet_payments = [t for t in all_transactions if 'internet' in t['description'].lower()]
total = sum(t['amount'] for t in internet_payments)
print(f"Total internet bill payments: {total}")
print(f"Number of transactions: {len(internet_payments)}")
